title: Battery range and charging behavior
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on battery range impressions alongside charging, preconditioning, and battery-status guidance, with most sampled mentions lacking clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise good battery range in winter or on the PHEV and note preconditioning as helpful for optimizing electric range.

negative.summary: Negative reviews express dissatisfaction with battery range, describing it as disappointing or explicitly unsatisfactory.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions discuss charging habits, range display behavior, battery drain, preheating indication, regenerative charging, and discharged or maintenance-warning batteries without enough context to label sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment read.
Several undetermined fragments are factual or advisory rather than evaluative, so the topic mixes owner impressions with service or usage guidance.
Examples span BEV, PHEV, and ICE contexts, including both traction-range discussion and conventional battery issues, which reduces topic coherence.
